TextBlock.Text: Defeat the three-bomber raid before it crosses the convoy defense line. Fictional 2025 operation; requires F-23A Block 40 and Block 40 Strike.
Two F-23s cover two supply ships. Three missile bombers approach from the east, screened by two fighters. Each bomber has a direct attack order against the convoy.

Prioritize the three bombers. Do not let a bomber reach the 35-nautical-mile convoy defense circle. Split missile allocations between the flight if needed. Your fighter screen begins 50 nautical miles east of the ships.

All three bombers destroyed, both supply ships alive, and no incoming weapons against the friendly force. A bomber breaching the defense circle, either supply ship lost, both fighters lost, neutral loss, or the deadline fails the mission.

Your aircraft start airborne and selected, with weapons and fuel loaded. Two-aircraft flights begin in Vic formation. Give route and attack orders to the flight leader, or detach a wingman for independent tasking.

Fictional naval F-23 development in September 2025. The carrier, supporting units and legacy opposition are scenario stand-ins. Radar silence does not guarantee invisibility. Neutral losses anywhere in the scenario fail the operation.
